working_tree: Uncommitted experimental implementation; tested surfaces identified by source hashes
implemented: Shared owned-note selection, reservation, local proof worker and reconciliation support purchases, withdrawals and consolidation without changing purchase record format
Consolidation combines two explicitly selected canonical unreserved notes into one freshly reserved owned output
Partial and full native withdrawals preserve accepted amount, payout, relayer, window and input/output slots under an immutable movement ID; full exit creates no dust note
Exact signed native transactions and declared lifetime fee reservations commit to the encrypted book before exposure; live retries and wallet reopen reuse the same signature, timestamp and nonce
A dedicated relayer has one unresolved live attempt; replacement needs native nonce consumption or timestamp expiry, a new canonical head and remaining immutable fee/attempt budget
Actual same-node native intake and peer announcement are used; staging is explicitly separate from canonical confirmation and note finalization

Confirmed native transaction lookup verifies the full exact envelope and successful exchange in authenticated retained finality, with historical code, factory, math/proof/value and native custody checks
Rejected transactions in epoch receipt data cannot satisfy successful exchange confirmation; VM receipt text is not used as payment authority

Automatic reconciliation imports owned output/change from canonical creation-epoch paths, preserves an early-imported change note later reserved elsewhere, and marks input notes spent only after actual confirmation
Historical append-prefix query reconstructs old note paths from the current index; actual canonical roots still authenticate every reconstructed path
Cancellation and expiry share the existing safe release rule: no exposed current-root proof can release notes; canonical root invalidation plus unspent inputs is required

actual_canonical_flow.scope: Local native intake plus signed canonical BFT execution; peer announcement has no external peer in this fixture.

tree_prefix_utility.scope: Only prefix query/tests added; removing those blocks and restoring their adjacent blank line recovers the exact prior source.

limits: No private routed client/kernel, public devnet/mainnet or alternate-host qualification; released shielded_required remains refused

Native intake integration currently uses the local BFT Submission capability; broader host adapters and automated client/commit scheduling remain unfinished
Canonical public index acquisition/replay remains caller-supplied; its roots/count are always checked against the real node before wallet use
Timestamp-expired/rejected nonce replacement, concurrent different-operation relayer contention and unexpected mixed/sponsored input spends need further adversarial qualification
Operator-income custody handoff and shared multiple-operator payer views remain unfinished
Private service-equivocation claims, zero-price grants, public onboarding abuse controls and key custody/backup tooling remain unfinished
Production circuit ceremony/cryptographic review remain required. Local test setup must not back real funds
No new theorem or full node parity claim. Existing circuit/AML/proof/transcript sources are unchanged; the new prefix helper is a non-authoritative query
Available wallet OCT excludes in-flight reserved notes; declared native fee reservations are conservative upper bounds, not protocol commission
No public deployment, remote source compilation, wallet funding or GitHub publication occurred
